source: Original wanted/reward tables and WantedInterface/HunterManager/TriggerManager bytecode; missing SERVER spawn config replaced by explicit local fallback

requests.rpc_s_complete_pve_battle: Existing result dict; trusted live battleResult.pve_dict.wantedDead determines wanted win

responses.enter: rpc_c_enter_battle; oppo.player.stage from wanted.stage, pve_mode=3, wanted_id=current target
responses.trigger: rpc_c_run_trigger({trigger_id,cid,config:buildWantedTargetTrigger(wantedId),args:{residerDead:1,bossMark}}); never look server IDs up in the unrelated local pve_trigger table
responses.settle: rpc_c_battle_result; no campaign unlock or generic stage loot
responses.claim: rpc_c_get_reward_after_hunter_pve_ans({reward_get}); original HunterManager speaker and Award UI

restored_values.target_selection: player_lv_info1..3, choose highest level band <= account level, normalize positive probability weights; exclude zero-weight entries
restored_values.win_fragments: All 27 positive-weight targets: fixed target fragment x4 via original putin_win chain
restored_values.gold_formula: floor(base * (1 + playerLevel * 0.5)); limited by existing storage capacity

persistence: Original DER event counters and cards; settlement commits localWantedReward and player wanted_id/wanted_reward/hunter_win before home; claim clears receipt before original display; display suppresses already-committed inputAward

local_spawn_fallback.reason: Server trigger metadata only has trigger_times; same numeric IDs in local pve_trigger are unrelated tutorial events that can pause combat or create allied actors
local_spawn_fallback.typeid: Family from wanted.speaker_id (else wantedId); start with family*100+1, follow hero_evolve entries whose type_required record has origin_typeid=current form and whose target stays in same family; choose card_order-th visual form
local_spawn_fallback.rebirth_correction: User expects visual evolution forms, not reborn_times enhancement count. 10401/10421/10441 load 10401/10402/10403.ccbi; old 10402/10403/10404 all load first-form 10401.ccbi.
local_spawn_fallback.skills: Keep original unit_battle.skill_nums[0]; additionally choose 1/2/3 distinct family-learnable skills uniformly without replacement, at skill level 10 (advanced interpreted as stock max level). Pool requires matching hero_to_skill and skill_to_hero.to_hero_id, positive learning weight in any tier, and valid skill_data[sid*100+10].
local_spawn_fallback.basic_attack_targets: After wantedTarget spawn ACK, copy only that instance default skill config via stock setTargetAirAvailable and set target_ground=1. Retain damage/range/actions/target faction and types, other skills and shared data.skill_data. Spawn status groundAndAir records application.
local_spawn_fallback.skill_selection_time: Once before entering battle, kept on pveSession.wantedTrigger and reused on spawn/retry
local_spawn_fallback.provenance: User-requested local difficulty, not recovered production spawn values
local_spawn_fallback.position: original trigger_pos_type=2 at destroyed hideout caller
local_spawn_fallback.promotion_resolution: After choosing visible form, follow upgrade_target 4/9/14 times within same battle_res; e.g. Dino 10405/10430/10455. Rank checked against original Chinese sub_name strings for all 27 enabled targets.

equipment.medium: Independent uniform t/x/y per slot 0..1; remaining slots null; native matching may activate a two-rune skill
equipment.advanced: Uniform choice from 9 stock rune_order keys of length 5; fill all five slot-specific forms, guaranteeing full five-rune skill at native level 2
equipment.attributes: One uniform original allowed attribute per base_attr/two_attr/three_attr layer; hero_attr=0, following current local rune generation policy
equipment.selection: Before entry, saved to session wantedTrigger.localWantedEquipment and reused on retry
equipment.delivery: runWantedTargetTrigger temporarily wraps current controller createUnit only for matching target type and defender camp; deep copies eqp before original components init, restores own/inherited method in finally; no shared tables changed

advanced_spawn_buff.scope: Only cardOrder=3 wanted target after stock spawn callback completes
advanced_spawn_buff.application: Original Buff.BuffManager.handleBuff(899801, unit.faction, bc.getCasterMir(), unit.cid) followed by runBuff(handle)
advanced_spawn_buff.deduplication: Per spawned BattleController _localWantedBuff899801 marker plus existing session.triggered guard
advanced_spawn_buff.lifecycle: Stock buff effect, timeout, removal and battle cleanup; never modify shared buff config or player save

local_spawn_fallback.basic_attack_field_targets: For default skill only, override its _castMagicField with castWantedGroundAndAirField: create original field, clone this MagicFieldObjects[handle].config, set air_land=0 before runMagicField. Fixes independent ground-only damage filtering in Pink Dragon 10801 and Mischief 10901. Shared fields, extra skills, radius and damage buff remain unchanged.

client_debits: Entry/help/diamond costs are paid by original UI; ticket subtraction occurs after callServer. Home RPCs run on next tick and snapshot those payments without another debit.
compatibility_limits: Enemy village reuses existing compatible PVE payload, not recovered production layouts or score-matching service.
Original WantedCard/Info does not consume wanted_control.open_level; do not add a new account-level RPC gate. User observed advanced card accessible at level 12.
Legacy zero-weight full-hero reward branches are not enabled.
Device natural target emergence, defeat, victory, home reward and ticket reset require retest.
